verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS collaboration platform like SharePoint, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, diagnostic-data or usage-tracking opt-out. The tenant-level SharePointSettings API is a general settings surface, not a documented telemetry control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
